description: Prices of the standard tier (PLAN.md phase 4, [M4]), checked on the providers' official price lists on 3.11.2026; the values of 1.11.2026 in PLAN.md did not change. Check again on the day of measurement and save the price lists. Reasoning tokens are billed as output. cachedInput = input read from cache; cacheWrite = input written to cache, only where the provider bills it separately.

openai.note: Short context (up to 272K input tokens). cacheWrite is the 30-minute cache write (12 h: 2.50). No temporary discount for this model on 3.11.2026.

anthropic.note: Cache hits are 0.05x the base input price on Sonnet 5.5. The full 1M context is at standard pricing. Global inference (inference_geo us costs 1.1x).

google.note: Introductory prices through 31.12.2026; from 1.1.2027 input 1.50, cache 0.15, output 7.50. Output includes thinking tokens. Implicit caching has no write or storage cost.

deepseek.note: Peak hours Mon–Fri 01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00 UTC (start included, end excluded); all other hours off-peak at half price. Chinese public holidays are off-peak in full: list their dates (UTC) in offPeakDates; none in November 2026. deepseek-flash is DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017.

xai.note: A request whose prompt reaches 200K tokens is billed at the higher rate (4 / 1 / 12) for all its tokens.

luna.note: Reproducibility test only. Short context (up to 272K input tokens); cacheWrite is the 30-minute cache write (12 h: 0.25).
